Hay

Back to materials database

Quick answer

Hay is chicken feed. Official pre-EA notes say wild grass yields it at any growth stage; because that predates Early Access, verify a small test in your current save. A current-build bush/container route remains a single-player lead.

How to get it

  1. Test a small patch of wild grass first. Official Alpha notes say any growth stage yields Hay, but that pre-EA method has not been reconfirmed in the current build.
  2. If that fails, one current-build player report suggests cutting bushes or searching crates and barrels on NPC farms. This is a lead to test, not a guaranteed drop table.

Where to look

  • Wild grass: the official source is historical Alpha documentation, so verify it in your current save before clearing a large area.
  • Bushes and NPC-farm crates/barrels: a single current-build player lead, with no confirmed drop rate or exact container list.

Main uses and linked content

When chickens arrive, first try cutting a small patch of wild grass; official Alpha notes say growth stage does not matter, but this has not been reverified in the current Early Access build. If that fails, a current-build report suggests bushes and NPC-farm crates/barrels, not a guaranteed drop table.

Related quest objectives

  • Chicken Coop Mission
    • Collect 15 hay.

These are the quests’ own configured objectives; they are not purchase prices, sell prices or quest rewards.

Linked quest recipes

  • Feathered Foes · Scarecrow × 2

These links come from existing recipes registered on quest entries; quantities are recipe records, not quest delivery amounts.

Uses in building entries

  • Coop × 15 (recorded shop offer)

What to do next

  1. For chickens, put Hay in the coop's interior trough or load a connected silo for automation, as described by the official moderator answer.
  2. For Chicken Coop Mission, prepare 15 Hay for its configured objective; for Feathered Foes, the linked Scarecrow recipe separately uses 2 Hay.
